method: Visual review of all 680 actual crops across 34 contact sheets; full-resolution checks of 16 originals for suspected truncation; measured actual divider lines on 11 boards and reinspected all 164 corrected crops across nine corrected contact sheets. Checked named costume features, complete silhouettes, hems, headwear, props and neighboring-cell contamination. FH022 original framing is separately retained for follow-up. This is an AI-assisted material review, not professional historical, cultural, equipment or whole-library certification.
